**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

**5. US vs Global?**

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy but cautious: IBIT (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +15.09%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +12.46%) ABOVE TREND, while Speculation Index in CORRECTION (→ flat) suggests monitoring momentum.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy and oil strong: BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) in CORRECTION (↓ falling) — industrial signal mixed.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy net positive: XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY and UNG (1W: +3.88% | 1M: -6.22%) RECOVERY, with broad oil ETFs showing ABOVE TREND strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND show coherent tech leadership. DIVERGENCE: CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION and several consumer/cyclicals (XLY 1W: -0.05% | 1M: +8.04%) CORRECTION — monitor for broader momentum fade.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and keeping credit risk under watch via HYG/LQD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, Semis SOXX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Biotech XBI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION, Materials broad weakness (Materials 1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.52%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/Crude BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and Copper CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX complacency ~20 (VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND); HYG/LQD credit health threshold ~0.75–0.80 (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +1.40%) NEUTRAL; LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION); Tech/Financial pivot XLK/XLF level ~3.12 (Tech vs Financials 3.1177 ↑ rising) — monitor SPY/TLT ~8.4 (Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising) for risk tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX falling (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND but credit stress HYG/LQD showing strain. Technology and semiconductors showing strength (XLK 1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98% ABOVE TREND; SOXX 1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58% ABOVE TREND); key divergence is copper/commodities (CPER 1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50% CORRECTION) and rising HYG/LQD signal to monitor.
